title: Brain scoring API — DEV contract (v0, inference-first)
description: ⚠️ CARRIES RAW TEXT — dev/dogfood machines only, never real users (docs/brain-serving-v0.md). The client sends the internal message view; the brain re-chunks with the vendored reference chunker (cross-checked against the client's chunk checksum), embeds via in-cluster dasein-embed, and runs the exact reference scoring path against curator_v4_prod.pt. The proxy only activates this path when DASEIN_BRAIN_URL is set AND DASEIN_BRAIN_DEV_RAW=1. Superseded by brain-api/v1 (vectors+features) once the local embedder + client featurization land.

grid_q.description: fixed-point score on the 1e-6 grid (engine SCORE_SCALE): q = round(sigmoid * 1_000_000)

gf.description: doom-head run-state input, client-computed loop_feats over the conversation's ACTION stream: [current loop fraction, trailing-3 mean, slope over 3 steps, trailing-6 fraction >= 0.34]. Slope can be negative. Omitted = doom not scored (v0 behavior). 4 bounded numbers — no text channel.

messages.description: to_internal view of the conversation (RAW TEXT — dev only)

live_gi.description: global indices into the parsed chunk array of the chunks still alive (client registries applied)

mask.description: rows within live_gi to decide this step (undecided newborns)

chunk_checksum.description: sha256 over '\n'.join('{step}:{kind}:{tokens}') of the client's parsed chunk array — the live cross-language chunker-parity guard; mismatch = 409, fail open

scores_q.description: one per live row; rows outside mask are exactly 1000000 (never cut)

tau_q.description: the checkpoint's calibrated tau for target_cov — constant per (ckpt, cov)

doom_q.description: sigmoid(doom head) on the 1e-6 grid — present iff the request carried gf, the checkpoint has a doom head, and a forward ran (empty live_gi/mask early-returns score nothing and omit it)

names.description: unique tool names (deduped last-wins), aligned with scores_q/tokens; [] = ineligible, serve full roster (fail-open)

tokens.description: len(sort_keys schema JSON)//4 — the mass unit prune() ranks on

score_rules_request.description: POST /v1/score/rules — rule head (curator_v4 within-run AUC 0.814). ⚠️ NOT wired into any proxy consumer yet: scores are served for bench calibration and dogfood inspection only.

tools.description: the request tool roster; the rule graph rides the same tool-spec build, so an empty roster is ineligible (fail-open {})

rules.description: candidate rules to score at `step`; omitted -> the bundle's rules.json subset with status active|always_on (for the shipped roster: rule1, rule2, rule3, rule4, rule6, rule7 — candidate/retired eids are never scored unrequested)

step.description: the fire step (client step index). A step with no step node — a pure-reasoning turn, or a numbering past the server's chunk pipeline — clamps to the nearest EARLIER step node (the vendored trainer clamp).

scores_q.description: eid -> quantized raw sigmoid(score_rules); {} = ineligible/failed -> fail open (ungated fire is the baseline)

text.description: the rule's directive text — SERVER-owned (rules.json / the request's candidate list); returning it is data-plane-clean (nothing of the user's leaves)

fire_step.description: echoes the requested fire step — the consumer's (eid, fire_step) dedupe key

rules.description: the scored roster at the CURRENT step, aligned with scores_q; [] on the fail-open path

tau_hint_q.description: ADVISORY ONLY (the rule-head handoff's ~0.15; scores are compressed, ranking is the signal) — the firing tau MUST be bench-calibrated per checkpoint before any consumer fires on it

description.description: restates the advisory-tau / no-consumer caveat on every response

score_gate_request.description: POST /v1/score/gate — gate/brief head (serve-the-brief decision). ⚠️ NOT wired into any proxy consumer yet.

tools.description: the request tool roster; the gate graph rides the same tool-spec build, so an empty roster is ineligible (fail-open)

brief.description: the codescout brief text (RAW TEXT — dev only); empty/blank -> fail-open shape

score_q.description: quantized raw sigmoid(score_gate); exactly 1000000 on the fail-open path (serve = never gate on error)

tau_q.description: constant 500000 — the reference's locked gate tau 0.5

fail_open.description: true when scoring was ineligible/failed (empty brief, empty roster, error) — the fail-open event marker (counted, alertable)

neighbors_request.description: POST /v1/neighbors — cross-trace neighbor cost baseline for the proxy's runaway signal. Called ONCE per conversation (the neighbor set is per-task constant; the client caches the result in its conversation memo).

task_text.description: the first user message's internal text[:2000] (RAW TEXT — dev only); the server embeds it with the request embed backend as the anchor query

nbr_cost_median.description: MEDIAN realized cost (cumulative billed input tokens) of the top-k (DASEIN_NEIGHBORS=16) nearest anchors carrying cost metadata; null when hoods are off or fewer than 4 costs were found — the runaway signal stays inert (reference semantics)

nbr_count.description: how many neighbor cost samples were found (0 when hoods are off / no task statement / pre-cost artifact)

neighbors_active.description: the hoods artifact is mounted (DASEIN_HOODS_PKL) — mirrors /v1/bundle neighbors
